balance_definition.rule: SUM(amount) WHERE spent = 0 GROUP BY address

heuristic_notice: Connections are heuristically reconstructed by allocating each input across a transaction's outputs in proportion to output value. A link does not prove ownership or direct transfer attribution.

graph_scope.note: Only addresses with a positive current unspent balance are shown. Links are included only when both endpoints are currently funded. Refreshing the scan adds newly funded addresses and removes addresses whose balance reaches zero.
